spans.s:
रप् रप् [cf. rt. लप्], cl. 1. P. रपति,
रराप, &c., Ved. to talk (frivolously),
chatter; to murmur; to praise, (Sāy. अरपत् =
अस्तौत्): Intens., Ved. रारपीति, to make a loud
crackling noise.
राप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said or spoken.
राप्य राप्य. See rt. रप्, p. 832, col. 3.

रपस् रपस्, अस्, n. [cf. रेपस्], defect, fault,
sin; hurt, injury, (Sāy. = पाप, but Ṛg-veda

. रपांसि = बाधकानि राक्षसादीनि, disturbing
or injurious Rākṣasas, &c.)

रप्श् रप्श्, a Vedic root, only occurring
in the pres. part. below and with the
preps. प्र and वि; [cf. वि-रप्श्.]

रप्शद्-ऊधन्, आ, आ or ध्नी, अ, Ved. having a
full or distended udder, (Sāy. = महोधस्क.)
